name: Moosend
description: Moosend is an email marketing and marketing automation platform providing email newsletter creation, landing page and subscription form builders, and visual workflow automation designed for growing businesses and budget-conscious marketers.
best_for: Positioned for small-to-mid businesses, ecommerce brands, creators, and agencies wanting high-volume email delivery, automation workflows, and landing pages with affordable entry pricing and unlimited sends.
features: Drag-and-drop email newsletter builder with responsive designer templates
Unlimited email sends on all Pro plan subscription tiers
Visual marketing automation workflow builder with pre-built event triggers and branching
Landing page and interactive subscription form creation with exit-intent popups
Real-time analytics reporting open rates, click heatmaps, and conversion tracking
AI subject line optimizer and content generation assistant

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Starts at $9/mo for up to 500 active subscribers (billed at $7.20/mo on annual prepay). Includes unlimited sends, automation workflows, landing pages, and forms.

tiers.name: Enterprise / Moosend+
tiers.notes: Custom pricing for high-volume senders, dedicated IP address, SSO SAML, priority account management, and custom reporting.

pros: Unlimited email sends included across all Pro subscription tiers
Highly competitive starting price ($9/month) based on active subscribers rather than total list size
Full-featured 30-day free trial supporting up to 1,000 subscribers without requiring a credit card
cons: No permanent free tier after the 30-day trial expires
Native integration catalog is smaller than Mailchimp or HubSpot

faq.question: Does Moosend have a free plan?
faq.answer: Moosend does not have a permanent free plan, but offers a 30-day free trial supporting up to 1,000 subscribers with no credit card required.

faq.question: How does Moosend pricing scale?
faq.answer: Moosend pricing scales by active subscriber count (subscribers who engaged within 6 months), starting at $9/month for 500 contacts, with unlimited email sends on all Pro tiers.

faq.question: Who owns Moosend?
faq.answer: Moosend was acquired by Constant Contact in June 2025 and operates as a distinct, cost-effective standalone email marketing product.

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining analytics, automations, and AI tools for integrated customer communications.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses wanting a wide app ecosystem and extensive template library

alternatives.name: Brevo
alternatives.description: An integrated marketing and CRM platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp, and chat campaigns with volume-based pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses with large contact lists who send targeted broadcasts and want built-in CRM and multi-channel messaging

alternatives.name: Constant Contact
alternatives.description: A digital marketing platform providing email and SMS campaigns, landing pages, and event marketing tools for small businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses and nonprofits wanting simple campaign tools with strong phone and live support

alternatives.name: Zoho Campaigns
alternatives.description: An AI-powered email, SMS, and WhatsApp marketing platform with contact-tier pricing and deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses already using or considering the wider Zoho suite who want low-cost, contact-tiered email marketing
